title: How a Godly Man Reviews His Own Year Before He Reviews Anyone Else's
caption:
Review season hits and most men reach for everyone else's report card first.

A godly man starts with his own name on the page. The standard he uses on himself in the mirror is harder than the one he'd ever hand a friend having a rough year. Get that order right and correction stops feeling like an attack.

Grade yourself before you grade the room.

#faith #humility #christianmen #selfcontrol #manofgod
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
